title: Practice 1: Perfective or imperfective? The prefixed verbs in use

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: The dog came running to us.
exercises.why: **подбежала** — past tense (feminine) of подбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: подбегать).  Prefix **под-, подо-**: approach (к + dat.; до + gen).

exercises.q: I didn't bring them here.
exercises.why: **приводил** — past tense (masculine) of приводить: imperfective (perfective partner: привести).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: The bee flew out of the window.
exercises.why: **вылетела** — past tense (feminine) of вылететь: perfective (imperfective partner: вылетать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: Tom ran out of the classroom.
exercises.why: **выбежал** — past tense (masculine) of выбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: выбегать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: Tom converted to Judaism.
exercises.why: **перешёл** — past tense (masculine) of перейти: perfective (imperfective partner: переходить).  Prefix **пере-**: movement across, from one point to another; through (через + acc.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: The cat ran up the tree.
exercises.why: **взбежал** — past tense (masculine) of взбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: взбегать).  Prefix **вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-**: movement upwards (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: It wasn't part of the plan.
exercises.why: **входило** — past tense (neuter) of входить: imperfective (perfective partner: войти).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: Did you spend the night with her?
exercises.why: **провела** — past tense (feminine) of провести: perfective (imperfective partner: проводить).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).

exercises.q: She climbed a tree.
exercises.why: **залезла** — past tense (feminine) of залезть: perfective (imperfective partner: залезать).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: The neighbors ran towards the noise.
exercises.why: **прибежали** — past tense (plural) of прибежать: perfective (imperfective partner: прибегать).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: I was just passing by.
exercises.why: **проезжал** — past tense (masculine) of проезжать: imperfective (perfective partner: проехать).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).

exercises.q: Everybody ran out into the hall.
exercises.why: **выбежали** — past tense (plural) of выбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: выбегать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: The dog came running to me.
exercises.why: **подбежала** — past tense (feminine) of подбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: подбегать).  Prefix **под-, подо-**: approach (к + dat.; до + gen).

exercises.q: I crossed the street.
exercises.why: **перешёл** — past tense (masculine) of перейти: perfective (imperfective partner: переходить).  Prefix **пере-**: movement across, from one point to another; through (через + acc.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: They crawled out of the cave.
exercises.why: **выползли** — past tense (plural) of выползти: perfective (imperfective partner: выползать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: The plane took off easily.
exercises.why: **взлетел** — past tense (masculine) of взлететь: perfective (imperfective partner: взлетать).  Prefix **вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-**: movement upwards (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: I crossed the street.
exercises.why: **перешла** — past tense (feminine) of перейти: perfective (imperfective partner: переходить).  Prefix **пере-**: movement across, from one point to another; through (через + acc.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: I ran upstairs.
exercises.why: **взбежал** — past tense (masculine) of взбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: взбегать).  Prefix **вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-**: movement upwards (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: Did you come by boat?
exercises.why: **приплыл** — past tense (masculine) of приплыть: perfective (imperfective partner: приплывать).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: What has brought you here?
exercises.why: **привело** — past tense (neuter) of привести: perfective (imperfective partner: приводить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).
